title: Northbeam TechWorks Parts: Sourcing, Holds, Deposits and Billing
content:
Parts on a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair job are sourced as the service's sourcing basis states, and a part is billed at its cost plus the service's markup, rounded to the cent.

## How long a job may wait

A job is held for parts for no longer than the service's parts hold days, counted from the day the job was held for parts. Parts hold days are counted as calendar days from the day the hold began, which counts as day zero, and a part that arrives late does not restart the count. The day the hold began is read from the work order, and the comparison is not-later-than, so a return to the work on the last day of the hold period is within the limit.

> **On a service allowing twenty-one days of hold.** The day the hold began counts as day zero. A return on day twenty-one falls on the last day the limit allows and is within it; a return on day twenty-two falls outside it. Where the part was expected on day ten and arrived on day nineteen, the count still runs from the day the hold began, because a late part does not restart it.

## Special-order parts

A special-order part is ordered only once the service's deposit percentage has been taken, and that deposit is set against the final bill rather than refunded separately.

## When the part does not come

Where the part has not arrived by the end of the hold days the job is escalated to the depot after the service's escalation days, and the customer is not billed for the wait.

## Parts that are not billed

A part fitted under a protection plan or under the manufacturer's warranty is not billed to the customer, and the markup is not applied to it either.

## A part that turns out not to be needed

A part ordered and then not needed is returned to stock and the deposit released, and the customer is billed nothing where the part was never fitted.

The per-service figures this standard reads — the markup, the business days a stocked part ordinarily takes, the calendar days a job may be held, the sourcing basis, the special-order deposit percentage and the escalation days — are carried in the parts schedule for the six TechWorks services.
